event_text: Tower Records confirms unauthorised access to Tower Records Online, stops the service and starts emergency maintenance
notes: The notice says 'about 17:10'. That is 3:10 AM Eastern the same day.

event_text: Company notice published; the company says no secondary harm from the leak was known as of this day
notes: Date only. The notice says it was published Nov 21 and updated Nov 22.

event_text: Company adds the counts update and the shipping plan: online-shop orders to start shipping Nov 23
notes: Time of the notice's latest update entry.
